name: 4-HO-MALT
summary: 4-HO-MALT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-methyl-N-allyltryptamine or as maltocin, is a tryptamine derivative related to 4-HO-DALT (dalocin) which has been sold as a designer drug, first being detected in Slovenia in 2020.

pharmacology.text: 4-HO-MALT acts as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors. It also interacts with other serotonin receptors. The drug produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: 4-HO-MALT was not included nor mentioned in Alexander Shulgin's book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved). However, it has subsequently emerged as a novel designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psilocin-like tryptamines, can cause nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類、類似脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（psilocin）的色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类、类似脱磷酸裸盖菇素（psilocin）的色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: The allyl group in its name comes from Allium, the Latin name of the garlic genus, because the group was first identified in compounds from garlic oil in the 1840s.
fact.zh: 它名字中的「烯丙基」（allyl）一詞來自大蒜所屬的蔥屬拉丁名Allium，因為這個基團在1840年代最早是從大蒜油的化合物中發現的。
fact.zhHans: 它名字中的「烯丙基」（allyl）一词来自大蒜所属的葱属拉丁名Allium，因为这个基团在1840年代最早是从大蒜油的化合物中发现的。
